evidence.snippet: Samsung is ending free access to the SmartThings API, with paid subscription tiers targeting availability in October 2026. Samsung is describing it as a developer pricing update, but the users most likely to feel the new Samsung SmartThings API pricing aren't software companies with engineering budgets they're hobbyists and power users who've relied on the API as a bridge between Samsung's ecosystem and more open platforms like Home Assistant. Free access remains confirmed through Q3, so [...] The SmartThings integration doesn't break that model entirely. Home Assistant still runs locally, and the vast majority of its integrations don't touch Samsung's API at all. But for users who rely on that specific bridge controlling Samsung-connected devices through Home Assistant what was a free connectivity layer becomes a billable service.
